notes.title: Halloween Update and Sale!
notes.notes:
Dismantle is 30% off for the Steam Halloween Sale!

We've just now pushed out an update with a couple of new Construct pieces, and a new themed power weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34414434/32b9ca93bec2f7b4510468d5d5991c0cc24e0031.gif[/img]

In other big news, Steam released a Remote Play Together option in beta last week, and we think it's great!
This allows you to play couch games like Dismantle over the internet, with distant friends sending their button presses to the game almost as if they were there with you.

Here's Valve's announcement on Remote Play:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Tutorial and new Abilities!
notes.notes:
G'day again folks, after a quiet couple of weeks, we're back with a big update to Dismantle. 
Patch Notes as follows:

Update 1.1.0:
New much requested Tutorial
More parts added
Two New Special Abilities:
[list]
[*] Incinerate
[*] Energy Barrage
[/list]
Changed Construct Presets
Various environmental tweaks
Preparation for Localisation
Various effect tweaks
Other bug fixes

To celebrate this, as well as launching on the Humble Store, Dismantle is 20% off for the next week!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/912390/Dismantle_Construct_Carnage/
https://www.humblebundle.com/store/dismantle-construct-carnage

notes.title: Another Update
notes.notes:
G'day folks,
We've released another update to the game, patch notes are as follows:


Update 1.0.3: (Friday 15/03/19)
Updated quality settings
Level Tweaks
More "Oil" changes
Improved attack animations for certain weapons
More parts added
Fix for a crash on older graphics cards on returning to the main menu
Feedback and prompts for using the trap switches on certain levels
Other bug fixes
